changeSet.author: MIND
changeSet.comment: Catalogo cerrado de categorias de incidencia con PK identity
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE cat_categoria_incidencia ( category_id NUMBER GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY, category_code VARCHAR2(20 CHAR) NOT NULL, category_name VARCHAR2(60 CHAR) NOT NULL, display_order NUMBER NOT NULL, is_active CHAR(1 CHAR) DEFAULT 'Y' NOT NULL, updated_at TIMESTAMP, updated_by NUMBER, CONSTRAINT pk_cat_categoria_incidencia PRIMARY KEY (category_id), CONSTRAINT uk_cat_categoria_code UNIQUE (category_code), CONSTRAINT uk_cat_categoria_display_order UNIQUE (display_order), CONSTRAINT ck_cat_categoria_code CHECK (category_code IN ('MOBILIARIO','CLIMATIZACION','AUDIOVISUAL','LIMPIEZA','OTROS')), CONSTRAINT ck_cat_categoria_name_len CHECK (LENGTH(TRIM(category_name)) BETWEEN 3 AND 60), CONSTRAINT ck_cat_categoria_is_active CHECK (is_active IN ('Y','N')) )

changeSet.author: MIND
changeSet.comment: Indice unico funcional que garantiza la unicidad de category_name sin distinguir mayusculas de minusculas
changeSet.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uk_cat_categoria_name_ci ON cat_categoria_incidencia (UPPER(category_name))

changeSet.author: MIND
changeSet.comment: Catalogo cerrado de estados del ciclo de vida de la incidencia. status_code y status_name son los nombres fisicos del inventario T.5 (ARC-106): son los que referencian incidencia.status_code e incidencia_historico.from_status / to_status

changeSet.author: MIND
changeSet.comment: Restricciones CHECK del catalogo de estados de incidencia
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE cat_estado_incidencia ADD CONSTRAINT ck_cat_estado_code CHECK (status_code IN ('ABIERTA','EN_CURSO','RESUELTA','CERRADA'))
ALTER TABLE cat_estado_incidencia ADD CONSTRAINT ck_cat_estado_is_terminal CHECK (is_terminal IN ('Y','N'))
ALTER TABLE cat_estado_incidencia ADD CONSTRAINT ck_cat_estado_is_active CHECK (is_active IN ('Y','N'))

rollback.sql: ALTER TABLE cat_estado_incidencia DROP CONSTRAINT ck_cat_estado_code
ALTER TABLE cat_estado_incidencia DROP CONSTRAINT ck_cat_estado_is_terminal
ALTER TABLE cat_estado_incidencia DROP CONSTRAINT ck_cat_estado_is_active

changeSet.author: MIND
changeSet.comment: Grafo de transiciones permitidas entre estados de incidencia, con PK identity y rol autorizado
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE cat_transicion_incidencia ( transition_id NUMBER GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY, from_status VARCHAR2(20 CHAR) NOT NULL, to_status VARCHAR2(20 CHAR) NOT NULL, allowed_role VARCHAR2(32 CHAR) NOT NULL, requires_assignee CHAR(1 CHAR) DEFAULT 'N' NOT NULL, requires_comment CHAR(1 CHAR) DEFAULT 'N' NOT NULL, is_active CHAR(1 CHAR) DEFAULT 'Y' NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT pk_cat_transicion_incidencia PRIMARY KEY (transition_id), CONSTRAINT uk_cat_transicion_from_to UNIQUE (from_status, to_status), CONSTRAINT ck_cat_transicion_distinct CHECK (from_status <> to_status), CONSTRAINT ck_cat_transicion_req_assignee CHECK (requires_assignee IN ('Y','N')), CONSTRAINT ck_cat_transicion_req_comment CHECK (requires_comment IN ('Y','N')), CONSTRAINT ck_cat_transicion_is_active CHECK (is_active IN ('Y','N')), CONSTRAINT fk_cat_transicion_from_status FOREIGN KEY (from_status) REFERENCES cat_estado_incidencia (status_code), CONSTRAINT fk_cat_transicion_to_status FOREIGN KEY (to_status) REFERENCES cat_estado_incidencia (status_code), CONSTRAINT fk_cat_transicion_allowed_role FOREIGN KEY (allowed_role) REFERENCES cat_rol (role_code) )
